title: Single-use Bureau runtime refresh after PR #2266 open-PR adoption fix
goal: Publish exactly one initially non-executable planned Bureau runtime-refresh authority through a protected one-file PR, adopt it missing-only into authoritative StateStore, and only then activate it by a proof-bearing planned-to-ready CAS. Its sole purpose is to converge the installed Bureau runtime and canonical Registry from 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271 to a freshly observed protected-main successor containing merged PR #2266 and this authority publication, so normal HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1-T009 claim admission can consume the verified-terminal open-PR adoption path fixed by PR #2266. This authority performs no T009 claim or dispatch, Heim-PC PR #125 merge, unrelated task reconciliation, unrelated repository mutation, or NixOS migration work.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound Bureau runtime/Registry convergence only after merged PR #2266 and this authority's own protected one-file publication. The authority may install one freshly observed protected-main successor derived from deployed source 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271 after proof-bearing StateStore activation. It grants no HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1-T009 claim or dispatch, no Heim-PC PR #125 merge, no NixOS production mutation, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or cutover, no queue, task-supply, unrelated repository, foreign-work or broad cleanup authority. Any failed, unclear or transport-ambiguous runtime effect is reconstructed before further action; no blind retry.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed. The exact target contains merged PR #2266, this authority publication, and all legitimate intermediate protected-main merges; validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness are successful for the exact target context. Any main, PR, check, target, source/manifest, or authority drift invalidates older observations and intents.

Before prepare-intent and again before apply, deployment-manifest source and canonical Registry source are identity-valid and equal. The registered deployed source 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271 is freshly proven as a Git ancestor of the selected protected-main target. Mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks fail-closed.

Before any runtime effect, authoritative StateStore exposes this exact task ID on a proof-bearing ready revision later than the initial missing-only adopted planned revision. That revision binds metadata.protected_publication_adoption to the real publication PR and merge commit and atomically adds the protected-publication-and-missing-only-adoption acceptance plus no-run evidence binding.

This authority starts at most one Bureau runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout, or transport-ambiguous outcomes are reconstructed from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, Registry, task lifecycle, and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry or foreign authority substitution is permitted.

After successful apply, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launchers, scheduler artifacts, and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed protected-main source commit. StateStore integrity and Bureau runtime identity are valid, and the installed source contains merged PR #2266 with the verified-terminal open-PR adoption fix required for normal HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1-T009 claim admission. This readback does not itself authorize a T009 claim, dispatch, or Heim-PC PR #125 merge.

The authority is consumed at most once and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence needed to make merged PR #2266 live. It grants no HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1-T009 claim or dispatch, no Heim-PC PR #125 merge, no NixOS production, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or cutover effect, no queue or task-supply authority, no unrelated repository mutation, no foreign-work authority, and no broad cleanup effect. After successful immutable readback, T009 must re-enter its own canonical claim and merge contract with fresh live evidence.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime at 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271 remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If publication/adoption, source ancestry, target freshness, CI, StateStore binding, execution-context writability, lease binding, or runtime effect becomes unclear, preserve all evidence and do not retry; reconciliation requires a separately authorized successor path. No T009, Heim-PC PR #125, unrelated task, or NixOS state is modified by rollback of this runtime-only authority.

metadata.source: Merged Bureau PR #2266 is protected main 4c1d55a36fa356e69eb6ddcee545ade31e9da762 while the installed Bureau runtime and canonical Registry remain identity-valid at 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271. Fresh runtime-refresh observation f25b7bdd6e6b3d587812c33ea4319b927a58af59848952e8430ff9099e1cac09 proves 2bbde8f2904dbe752cf1a4648abae71ced2f0271 is the merge base/ancestor of protected main 4c1d55a36fa356e69eb6ddcee545ade31e9da762 with all required checks green. A new purpose-bound single-use authority is required because historical ready, planned, or verified authorities are purpose-, source-, publication-, target-, and single-use-bound and must not be repurposed.

publication_path.reason: Installed Bureau runtime/Registry predates merged PR #2266. Existing historical authorities are not reused because their purpose, source, publication, target, or single-use bindings differ. The publication grants no T009 claim/merge or NixOS effect.
